title: Business License
description: A local business license or business tax receipt: the issuing authority, the licence period, the business and its owner, the business classification, and the fees paid.

issuing_authority.description: The government office that issued the license or receipt.

name.description: Name of the issuing jurisdiction or office as printed in the title, e.g. Broward County.

address.description: Street address of the issuing office.

phone.description: Phone number of the issuing office.

document_title.description: Title of the document as printed, e.g. LOCAL BUSINESS TAX RECEIPT or BUSINESS LICENSE.

receipt_number.description: The license or receipt number printed beside 'Receipt #' or 'License #' in the header block, exactly as printed. Not the payment validation number.

valid_from.description: First day of the period the license is valid for, as YYYY-MM-DD.

valid_through.description: Last day of the period the license is valid for, as YYYY-MM-DD.

name.description: Business name or DBA as printed.

owner_name.description: Name of the owner as printed.

business_type.description: Business type or classification exactly as printed, including any parenthetical subcategory.

date_opened.description: Date the business opened, as YYYY-MM-DD.

state_license_or_registration.description: State, county or certification registration number, or null if blank.

exemption_code.description: Exemption code, or null if blank.

mailing_address.description: Mailing address block as printed, including the addressee line.

capacity.description: The counts the tax is assessed on. Null where a count is blank.

rooms.description: Number of rooms, or null if blank.

seats.description: Number of seats, or null if blank.

employees.description: Number of employees, or null if blank.

machines.description: Number of machines, or null if blank.

professionals.description: Number of professionals, or null if blank.

payment.description: The payment validation stamp, usually at the foot of the receipt.

validation_number.description: Receipt or validation number printed in the payment stamp, exactly as printed.

amount_paid.description: Amount shown in the payment stamp, in dollars.

is_regulatory_license.description: False if the document states that it is non-regulatory or does not indicate the business is legal or compliant; true otherwise.
